notes: Cats: United States in the Régionale bank (5 of its 61 stems are New York) and Pacific NW, NY & Canada in the Village bank (7 of its 33). Chapters: the Régionale chapter newyork, this subject's own, and the Village chapter Pacific NW, NY & Canada (fact New York). Regions: finger-lakes and long-island, the Court's Introductory AVA and one of its three Certified ones; the Hudson River Region and Lake Erie have no article and are taught in the new-york country record. Country: new-york for the three families of vine, Frank, the eleven AVAs and the labrusca 51 per cent. Grapes: the six vinifera the Court names, all profiled; Aurore, Seyval Blanc and Concord have no profile. Technique: phylloxera-rootstocks, the door to Frank's grafted vinifera and the American species. No service table: the Court's service and pairing rows are blank.
